description: The bar chart illustrates the sample counts for four essay genres—Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository—categorized by two response types: “Open” (light blue) and “Cons.” (light pink), likely short for “Consensus” or “Constrained.” The vertical axis, labeled “Sample Count,” ranges from 0 to 130 in increments of 20. For Argumentative essays, the Open count is 79 and Cons. is 122; for Narrative, Open is 80 and Cons. is 87; for Descriptive, Open is 68 and Cons. is 100; and for Expository, Open is 62 and Cons. is 130. Across all genres, the Cons. category consistently has a higher sample count than Open, with the largest difference observed in the Expository genre (68 vs. 130). The bars are grouped by genre along the horizontal axis, with each genre containing two adjacent bars for direct comparison. The chart visually emphasizes the disparity between the two response types, particularly in Expository and Argumentative essays, suggesting that consensus-based or constrained responses are more prevalent or better represented in the EssayBench dataset for these genres.
